tool_description: Performs an NCBI Entrez EFetch to retrieve full records for given UIDs. Accepts list or comma-separated string, respects rate limits, and returns the raw response (JSON if available, otherwise XML or text).

id_list.description: List of UIDs (array) or comma-separated UIDs (string).

output_schema.description: The raw text response from EFetch (usually JSON or XML).
